domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction)

skills.name: Convert to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and whole numbers when needed) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction n = (n·d)/d to match a target denominator
exclusion_criteria: A step only finds a common denominator between two proper fractions without converting any mixed/whole number
A step only reduces/simplifies a fraction after computation

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common (often least common) denominator for fractions and rewrite each as an equivalent fraction over that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM or chooses a common denominator for unlike denominators
A step scales numerator and denominator to rewrite one or more fractions over the chosen common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and the work proceeds directly to subtract numerators
A step only converts mixed numbers to improper fractions without addressing unlike denominators between the two quantities

skills.name: Subtract rationals
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers once they are expressed in compatible form (e.g., same denominator and/or separated whole and fractional parts).
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a shared denominator (a/d − b/d = (a−b)/d), including the case where the denominators were already equal
A step subtracts mixed numbers by subtracting whole parts and fractional parts and combining the result
exclusion_criteria: A step only performs conversions (mixed ↔ improper) or finds a common denominator without actually subtracting
A step only simplifies/reduces or converts the final result after subtraction

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Express the computed result in simplest accepted form by reducing fractions and/or converting between improper fractions, mixed numbers, and integers when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
A step recognizes and rewrites results equivalent to an integer (e.g., 0/3 → 0, 8/8 → 1)
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number (or notes the mixed-number equivalent) as final formatting
exclusion_criteria: A step only performs the subtraction without any reduction or final-form conversion
A step only finds a common denominator or converts inputs before subtraction
